remarks: A very stylish complex, "Woodland Manor," located in the prime area of Glenbrook, with it's own commuter train station, shopping centers, schools, and nearby vibrate down town Stamford.  The unit offers privacy situated in a 4 unit separate detached building #7. A townhouse offering pristine hardwood floor in the living/dining area, a cooks kitchen with newer quarts counters and stainless appliances. Adjacent guest powder room, on the main level. Upper level bedrooms sharing a updated bathroom and attic storage access. Lower Level finished space for a home office/rec room, with a laundry room & storage. Exit slider to direct parking space #4, with  plenty of visitor parking. In summer, enjoy the amenity of the in-ground swimming pool.
